title: KNIGHTLE - a wordle-like daily dungeon crawler + online 1v1 and 2v2s
author: Tryndakels
selftext:
https://knightle.io is a free browser game that mixes Wordle with a fantasy dungeon crawler, and its live for you to try now.  
Green and yellow letters deal damage, solving the word finishes the enemy, and your health carries between fights.  
Each enemy has its own mechanics, and there’s a timed strike mechanic that lets you do more damage out of your attacks.  
There’s a lot beyond the daily dungeon:  
Permanent XP levels and ascensions

1v1 ranked duels along with private matches up to 4 players where you can play 2v2s or King of the Hill

Armor sets with different bonuses, plus dyes, animated auras, backgrounds, borders, nameplates and keyboard styles. I also added my dog and cat as armor sets

Feats and achievement rewards, with equipment unlocked through levels, challenges and gold

Blessings (Augments) that change your run, along with healing, shields, revives, XP boosts and rerun tokens in the Tavern shop

Gold, rubies and dragon teeth to earn and spend on different upgrades and unlocks.

Dreaded Descent, a harder dungeon with longer words, different enemies and new mechanics.

Crimson Castle, where you can forge swords with rubies (a rare currency found in runs) and see your accumulated treasure.

Last Call, a tavern timing game where you try to keep a drinking streak going while earning gold and XP.

Lucky Cap, a daily pachinko minigame with equipment, cosmetics and other rewards.

Friends, leaderboards, personal records and stats for comparing how your runs went.

It runs in your browser on mobile or desktop, with no download. You can play as a guest or make an account to keep your progress across devices. It’s free to play, with ads (which are currently not in game yet) and an optional Royal Deed purchase that removes ads and adds bonuses.  
here’s the link again: https://knightle.io

comments.body: u/Tryndakels please expand this post with how you used AI during development. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're trying to avoid a sub full of drive-by plugs. If you don't update, this may be removed.

comments.author: No_Bass_8636
comments.body: Fun game and the idea has legs, but the art is terrible. If you focus on getting that fixed (either much better AI art or paid/free assets) I think you could have a good mobile game
